section_title: 1. National Opioid Settlement: In Purdue Pharma L.P. et al., United
text: GARY SINGH, Mayor SCOTT SAKAKIHARA, Vice Mayor (District 4) LANCE NISHIHIRA, Councilmember (District 1) JAIME PATIÑO, Councilmember (District 2) JEFF WANG, Councilmember (District 3) Tuesday, September 9, 2025 | 5:00 PM City Hall – City Council Conference Room 34009 Alvarado-Niles Road, Union City, CA 94587 This special meeting consists of a live “mock meeting” to continue hands-on testing of the OneMeeting agenda management system. The Council and staff will practice motions, voting, and public comment workflows. No actions will be taken during the mock meeting. Council will go into a Special Closed Session afterwards. 1. 2. 3.
